when_used: A person applies to the Land Registrar to register a restriction on the Proprietorship Section of the register, stating the grounds, the nature of the restriction and how long it is to run.

body_text.text: The Applicant HEREBY APPLIES to the Registrar to register a restriction on the Proprietorship Section of the Register.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this application for a restriction has been duly executed this........................…. day of……………………..20…………….

custom_fields.name: grounds
custom_fields.label: Grounds of application for the restriction
custom_fields.prompt: The grounds on which the restriction is applied for, one ground per line

custom_fields.name: restriction_nature
custom_fields.label: Nature of the restriction
custom_fields.prompt: What the restriction is to prohibit or require, for example no dealing without the consent of the applicant

custom_fields.name: restriction_duration
custom_fields.label: Duration of the restriction
custom_fields.prompt: How long the restriction is to run, for example until further order or for a stated period
